text:
mia: Quick sync prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/footer-mini-v2 idea: tiny streaming footer with token pill, stop/regenerate cluster, and a compact prompt quick-insert. Need takes on labels, visibility rules, and a11y. bryan: Footer next to send feels most discoverable. If we hide it in the rail users miss it while composing. sasha: Agree. Show token meter only while streaming by default, with a user setting to pin it. New users shouldn't be overwhelmed. oliver: Backend note: we don't reliably support resume semantics. 'Pause' would mislead. Use 'Stop' (discard partial output). a11y: Accessibility checklist: - token counter: aria-live="polite" with debounce (recommend 500ms) to avoid screen reader spam - streaming pulse: aria-hidden="true" to avoid announcements - stop button: explicit aria-label e.g. "Stop response and discard partial output" - final announcement: role="status" text: "Response complete. X tokens used." - respect prefers-reduced-motion for pulse animations mia: Good. Microcopy: regen label as 'Regenerate' and tooltip 'Regenerate response with same prompt'. Token tooltip: 'Tokens used (prompt + output)'. bryan: Visual nit: token pill contrast on light theme fails. Use bg #0F172A with #F9FAFB text or add a 1px neutral border. Also add a tiny 'tokens' sublabel under the pill for clarity. sasha: Keyboard flow: don't move focus on stream start; ensure Stop reachable in one Tab after Send. Add Esc as a shortcut to stop. Also consider announcing the stop via role=status so screen readers hear it. mia: Prompt library: keep full library in rail. Footer can have a compact quick-insert popover for recent prompts to avoid context switching. a11y: Recommend debounce announcements max 500ms and always announce final token count on completion. Use aria-atomic=false for the counter and aria-live=polite. Example:
Tokens: 124
oliver: I'll add Esc handler and ensure stop is not destructive unless user confirms in certain flows (e.g., long-running ops). bryan: I'll update the Figma and include the contrast fix and sublabel. Will post screenshots when ready. mia: Thanks all! I'll document decisions in the PR and tag @design for final sign-off. :sparkles:
